item.title: The Hospital Worker Who Hid A Horrifying Secret
item.description: David Fuller appeared to live an ordinary life while working at hospitals in England, but investigators uncovered a series of crimes that stunned the nation. What began as a murder investigation exposed decades of shocking offenses, making it one of the most disturbing criminal cases in modern British history.

item.title: He Planned A Massacre To Be With His Online Girlfriend
item.description: Richard McCroskey traveled across the country to meet his online girlfriend, but the visit ended in unimaginable violence. Investigators uncovered a chilling, premeditated plan that left multiple people dead and revealed the dark obsession behind one of Virginia's most disturbing mass murder cases.

item.title: The 88 Days That Changed Jayme Closs Forever
item.description: Thirteen-year-old Jayme Closs was kidnapped after a gunman murdered her parents inside their Wisconsin home. After surviving 88 terrifying days in captivity, her extraordinary escape shocked the nation and brought one of the most haunting child abduction cases in recent history to an end.

item.title: The Childhood That Shaped A Future Killer
item.description: Nikko Jenkins endured a childhood marked by violence, instability, and repeated time in juvenile detention long before he became one of Nebraska's most notorious killers. His early years have since become central to understanding the path that led to a shocking series of murders.

item.title: The Shocking Crime Of Suzane Von Richthofen
item.description: Suzane von Richthofen was convicted of helping orchestrate the 2002 murders of her parents, Manfred and Marísia von Richthofen, alongside her boyfriend and his brother. The case stunned Brazil, exposing a carefully planned crime driven by family conflict and personal motives, and remains one of the country's most infamous murder cases.

item.title: She Was Accused Of Killing Two Husbands
item.description: Colleen Ann Harris was convicted of murdering her third husband, Robert Harris, after fatally shooting him as he slept in their California home in 2013. Decades earlier, she had also been tried for the death of another husband but was acquitted. The second conviction cemented her reputation as one of California's most notorious "black widow" killers.
